title: Zelensky on overnight attack: Russia targeted energy, logistics, and urban infrastructure almost everywhere
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky, commenting on a new Russian attack involving ballistic missiles, said that artificial and prolonged delays in deliveries of interceptors for Patriot and NASAMS air defense systems directly help Russia achieve the objectives of its terrorist campaign.

title: Russian forces observing ceasefire in Oleshky as of 9 a.m., Ukrainian Marines say
summary: As of 9 a.m., Russian forces were observing the ceasefire in the area of Oleshky where a humanitarian mission is being conducted.

title: Most of Konotop without power for fourth day after Russian Strikes; water supplied on schedule
summary: Much of Konotop, in Ukraine’s Sumy region, has been without electricity for the fourth consecutive day following Russian strikes.

title: Three killed, eight injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv Region over past day
summary: Three people were killed and eight others injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv and 12 other settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past day.

title: Romania uncovers Russian-coordinated sabotage network suspected of setting fire near defense facility
summary: Romania's Intelligence Service said on Monday it had identified a sabotage network coordinated by Russia, which it believed was responsible for a fire in September at an industrial site in central Romania near a state-owned weapons company.

title: Air defenses neutralize two ballistic missiles, 255 drones in overnight Russian attack on Ukraine
summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces shot down two ballistic missiles and neutralized 255 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine beginning on the evening of October 26.

title: Humanitarian mission gets underway in Oleshky, Budanov says
summary: A humanitarian mission has got underway in Oleshky, with a bilateral ceasefire declared in the area of the operation.

title: War update: 196 combat engagements on frontline in past day as Russian pressure intensifies  on Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka axes
summary: A total of 196 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian troops were reported along the front line on October 26.

title: Specialists assess damage to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge after ballistic missile strike
summary: Specialists are assessing damage to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge following a Russian ballistic missile strike overnight on October 27.

title: Russian attack on Kyiv kills one person and injures 14
summary: Since the evening of October 26, one person has been killed and 14 others wounded as a result of enemy attacks on the capital.

title: Russia loses another 1,400 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
summary: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to October 27, 2026—amount to approximately 1,581,840 personnel, including 1,400 over the past 24 hours.

title: Russian nighttime attack on Kyiv causes several hits, including on administrative building
summary: As a result of yet another ballistic attack by Russian forces in the Podilsky district of the capital, an administrative building was hit.

title: Zelensky after Russian strike on Kyiv: Delays in air defense support Ukraine enable terrorism
summary: Amid the constant threat of Russian airstrikes, artificial delays in the delivery of air defense systems to protect Ukraine only serve to fuel terror.

title: Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv kills one, injures 10 and damages medical facilities and school
summary: During the air raid alert in the capital, explosions were heard—Russian forces attacked the city with ballistic missiles.

title: Melania Trump’s chief adviser: Russia pledges to respect Oleshky residents’ evacuation choices
summary: Russia has assured Ukraine and the United States that it will respect the choice of residents of the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region regarding their evacuation destination.

title: Zelensky enacts NSDC decision on national security strategy
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has enacted the decision of the National Security and Defense Council “On Updating Ukraine’s National Security Strategy.”

title: Russia expanding recruitment of African mercenaries amid heavy losses in Ukraine war – Bloomberg
summary: Russia is expanding the range of African countries from which it recruits men to address a shortage of personnel in its armed forces amid the war against Ukraine, where it is suffering heavy losses.

title: Economy Ministry again revises 2026 GDP forecast downward
summary: The Ministry of Economy is once again revising its forecast for GDP growth in 2026, this time toward a lower estimate.

title: More than 40 sets of World War II remains exhumed in Mlyniv, Rivne region
summary: In the village of Mlyniv in the Rivne region, search teams exhumed more than 40 sets of human remains of people who died during World War II; these remains were later reburied at the Memorial of Glory.

title: Partisans gather intelligence on security at substation in Russian-occupied Dzhankoi
summary: An agent of the ATESH partisan movement serving in the Russian Armed Forces has provided information on the security arrangements at the Vostochnaya substation (Dzhankoi substation) in temporarily occupied Crimea, which is guarded by Russian troops.

title: Polish Sejm Speaker: Threat from Russia is growing
summary: Polish Sejm Speaker Włodzimierz Czarzasty has called for Russia’s actions to be monitored on a daily basis, saying the threat from Moscow is growing, although there is no reason to panic.

title: Battlefield in Kherson Region’s island area is now “transparent”,  military says
summary: Thanks to technology, the battlefield in the island area of the Kherson region is now “transparent.” Attempts by Russian forces to advance and establish positions end with their destruction, while Russian troops have failed to land in Kherson’s Korabel neighborhood.
